dataset.description: This research examines the effectiveness of inflation targeting as a monetary policy strategy in conditions of heightened economic uncertainty. By analyzing empirical evidence across varying contexts, it evaluates the stability, adaptability, and outcomes of inflation-targeting frameworks, highlighting their efficiency in achieving price stability and mitigating adverse economic impacts during uncertain times.
keyword: Inflation targeting, emerging economies, central bank, policy.
dataset.title: COMPARING THE EVIDENCE OF INFLATION TARGETING EFFICIENCY UNDER HIGH UNCERTAINTY

dmp.description:
The research is aimed to measure and describe the features of the monetary transmission mechanism in stable and critical periods for a set of economies.
It features the aggregated cross-sectional data from a number of international organizations in comparison with the data from the National Bank of Ukraine

project.description: National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy Doctoral Programme
project.title: National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy Doctoral Programme

dmp.title: Measures of the monetary transmission efficiency
